description: This file defines enums, structs, and error handling logic related to gateway connection authentication and error responses for the OpenClawKit project. It includes specific error codes, recovery steps, and structured error types for handling websocket connect-auth failures.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: Structured error for websocket connect-auth rejection, including message, detail code, recovery step, and retry capability.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: Error representing a gateway response with { ok: false }, including method, code, message, and details.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: Error indicating a decoding failure related to gateway communication.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializer for GatewayConnectAuthError, sanitizing input strings.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializer for GatewayResponseError, setting default code or message if input is empty.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializer for GatewayDecodingError, setting method and message.
